name: AMEGO
summary: AMEGO is a larger Probe-class concept for a proposed low Earth orbit. It is cataloged separately from AMEGO-X, which uses pixel detectors and has a different budget and energy range.
detection_principle: Double-sided silicon-strip tracking and two types of calorimeter reconstruct both Compton and pair-conversion events, covering the MeV gap to study dark-matter-related radiation and conventional astrophysical backgrounds.

results.summary: The collaboration discusses MeV dark-matter science objectives as a future capability.

science_scope: Searches cosmic gamma-ray, antiparticle or neutrino spectra, directions and fluxes for indirect signatures of dark-matter annihilation, decay or related new physics. Conventional astrophysical sources and propagation can produce similar signals, requiring background modeling; design sensitivity is not a measured limit or discovery.
